source_semantics.control: When CurrentUserChip has an active site, the source workspace actions expose a visible Settings link to /sites/{activeSiteId}/settings.
source_semantics.read_only: The canonical control is navigation only. It does not itself save site settings, mutate WordPress, enqueue work, or claim success.

laravel_adaptation.frontend: resources/js/current-user-site-details-control.tsx renders Settings only from authoritative active_site context, sites.view permission, and the exact tenant-scoped sites.detail.{id} contract.
laravel_adaptation.destination: SiteSettingsRouteServiceProvider registers explicit /tenants/{tenant}/sites/{site}/settings under auth + tenant.context and binds the route to the canonical operation ID.
laravel_adaptation.read_authority: SiteSettingsReadController authorizes tenant.view and sites.view, then reads the Site through the active tenant scope and renders persisted name, URL, and status without mutation.
laravel_adaptation.guard: The CurrentUserChip settings link fails closed without an active site, sites.view, or the exact active-site API contract; foreign tenant site IDs resolve 404 through TenantContext and Site tenant scoping.

proofs: exact canonical PENDING operation identity and CurrentUserChip source at implementation stage
real visible Settings control carries the canonical operation marker and active-tenant destination
explicit authenticated tenant-scoped settings destination with tenant.view and sites.view authorization
persisted Site name, URL, and status are reread without mutation
guest, missing-permission, and Tenant A to Tenant B direct-ID paths fail closed
missing active-site or mismatched API context never synthesizes a settings destination
